svg.title: The Star of Victoria: construction sheet
svg.desc: Construction grid for the eight-pointed version at 1:2, with every measure as a ratio of the hoist A: star centre C 0.8 A from the hoist and D 0.5 A from the head, star width E 0.6 A, circumradius F 0.3 A, inner radius G 0.15 A, margin H 0.2 A, and the colours #A80431 and #FFFFFF.
svg.text: Every measure is a ratio of the hoist, A.
Row one: ratio to the hoist. Row two: on a 600 hoist.
Brodie O’Dunn, after the flag of 1844
